draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.32, the 51st-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 9th of 23 at DE. He lasted until pick 123, well after his grade rank (51st): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 9 sacks in 2024, 7th of 23 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Pittsburgh Steelers. 17 career games and 1 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Weak spots: sacks 1.0 (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 edge rusher who played: 1.0 sacks against a median of 1.0 (level with).
